description: The file contains a markdown document describing the usage and implementation of a file observer class that monitors filesystem changes using inotify on Linux systems. It includes explanations, example C++ class implementation, and usage examples.

classes.name: FileChangeMonitor
classes.description: A class implementing a filesystem monitor callback that registers with a FileSystemMonitor instance to observe changes on a specified file or directory, and provides a callback method 'Updated()' that triggers upon change notification.

methods.name: FileChangeMonitor::Updated
methods.description: Callback invoked when the monitored file or directory changes, printing a message indicating the change.
